applicable_mersen_conditions.time_constant_basis: '*Time Constant: L/R <=1ms' in the DC tables (p.3/HS2, p.7/HS6); the A70QS page uses 'L/R <=10ms' and '10ms time constant' interchangeably

time_constant_reconciliation.why: the catalogue defines its DC time constant as L/R; R*C is not a manufacturer condition and does not describe the discharge at low damping

peak_corner.note: the dispatch/receipt cite 714x at this corner; that factor is 2L/R : R*C. L/R : R*C is 357x.

time_constant_reconciliation.withdrawn: AR-COORD's comparison of R*C <= 1.43 ms against the 2.5 ms figure

joint_mapping.method: a cell qualifies only if the pre-arcing ACTION screen is met AND L/R is within the stated cap-discharge condition AND the voltage/current limits are respected

action_screen.kind: pre-arcing action screen, not a melting result

voltage_check.model_note: the most underdamped cell can swing the loop voltage toward ~2x V0 (~800 V peak-to-peak), still below 890 V

current_check.caveat: the 100 kA figure is the general DC I.R. at L/R = 11.6 ms; no peak limit is published separately for the 890 VDC cap-discharge condition

joint_mapping.region_expression: {R : 400*L <= R <= 0.64013 ohm} on the grid; R in [5 mOhm, 0.5 ohm], L in [20 nH, 20 uH]

oracle_scope.validates: the R-L-C arithmetic only (peak against V0/Z0 and V0/R; action against E/R)
oracle_scope.does_not_validate: the translation of that arithmetic into Mersen's qualification conditions; class guidance is not demonstrated coordination
